title: Lovely Smoky Malaysian Sausages Satay
description: A malty, dense, and romantic Malaysian dish featuring smoky sausages wrapped in ti leaves, perfect for a special occasion. This shojin-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.

ingredients.name: Malaysian sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably made with chicken or beef

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, peanut oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Add the Malaysian sausages to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Wrap each sausage in a ti leaf, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Grill the satay for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the ti leaves are charred and the sausages are cooked through.
Serve the satay hot with additional peanut sauce for dipping, if desired.
Garnish with sliced onions, cucumbers, and ketupat, if desired.
